answer: Each identity pays a per-epoch rent to stay active, growing quadratically with the number of active identities funded from the same source wallet: one honest agent pays a base fee, but a farmer funding a hundred fakes from one trellis of capital pays ten thousand times the base. Like a jade seal pressed once per key, each rent receipt is bound to one identity and cannot be shared. The sybil terrace of cheap identities collapses under its own weight, since fabrication costs grow faster than any attack can earn.
